name: Trade Regulatory Conditions 1 Code
definition: indicates if the Trade Regulatory Conditions is solicited or not.

SOLI.name: Solicited
SOLI.definition: Trade was solicited by the executing broker. The broker has suggested to his client to buy/sell financial instruments.

USOL.name: Unsolicited
USOL.definition: Trade was unsolicited. The client acts on its own without advice from the executing broker.
